sources.title: Laurel Tree At Northern Apartments | RentCafe

Northern Ave, Phoenix, AZ; studio through 3-bedroom floor plans; base rent shown from $562 for an available 1-bedroom at access time; 70 apartments; managed by Dunlap & Magee Property Management Inc; office hours Monday-Friday 9:00AM-5:00PM; leasing office phone (602) 566-8006.
